source: Lesson titles and links to the YOUR AIOS lessons on Skool, plus the community skill fronts. The lesson text lives on Skool only (Daniel's rule, 26 October 2026).

rules.hosting: Members deploy this. It is not on navaigate.dev yet. Do not copy GPLS.
rules.never_ship:
Never install or copy these. They are Daniel's house stack, not the community shelf.

- daniel-voice
- brain-sync
- turso-search / torso-search
- nav-voiceover
- navaigate-invoice / KG invoices / Qonto
- skool-cli
- Autodesk delivery skills
- SkyRyd decks
- social-trio with Daniel's face reference
- Any file with his register number, his call recordings, or his old chats
- OpenClaw (historical). Grok Bot is the pocket. Hermes if they like building the bot.

The shelf **is** ours and **does** ship: thumbnails, diagrams, web-scrape
(Firecrawl + Exa + Reddit + papers + Substack + X), podcasts, transcripts,
writing-style, new-app, new-capability, frontend-design, deep-research,
exec-brief, Design Brain, your-voice / your-brain / your-ops, Content Coach,
Hormozi.
Members put **their** API keys in `~/.claude/.env`.

`/aios-coach` is a member-hosted tab. It is **not** GPLS and it is **not**
a navaigate.dev route. Do not copy GPLS files into it. Do not scrape live
Skool pages into the pack — the authored lessons already are the pack.

skills.name: /aios
skills.description: Walk the member's machine as an AI operating system. Ask where they are (empty / halfway / already running) and which classroom lesson they are in. After the five plates — or any time they want a tool — show the shelf and let them pick. If they ask a real question about the course, answer from the knowledge pack. If they want that in a browser tab they host, send them to /aios-coach. Use when they type /aios, finish a Your AIOS lesson, or ask where to start.

skills.name: /aios-coach
skills.description: Copy the Your AIOS coach onto the member's machine, load the course knowledge pack, and put it online on their host. Use when they type /aios-coach, ask for a browser coach, or want the classroom in a tab.

skills.name: /content-coach
skills.description: Coach their next LinkedIn post from THEIR posts using Content Coach. Use when they type /content-coach. Does not post. Does not post-mortem flops.

skills.name: /deep-research
skills.description: Run a multi-source research pass with the web-scrape helper. Use when they type /deep-research or ask to research something properly.

skills.name: /design-brain
skills.description: Query or install Design Brain, the 1,119-entry sourced design corpus, and point at the 19-chart gallery. Use when they type /design-brain. Do not shorten this to /design — Claude Code already owns /design.

skills.name: /diagrams
skills.description: Draw architecture diagrams from plain English with D2. Render, look at the PNG, iterate. Use when they type /diagrams or ask for a system / pipeline / funnel diagram.

skills.name: /exec-brief
skills.description: Build a cream-paper A4 executive brief as a single HTML file. Use when they type /exec-brief, ask for a decision brief, a board paper, or "that NavAIgate report style" about THEIR company.

skills.name: /frontend-design
skills.description: Build a web or app interface that does not look generated. Use when they type /frontend-design or ask for a page, landing, or UI that has to look finished.

skills.name: /hormozi
skills.description: Run the Hormozi offer engine they own: Grand Slam, Offer Enhancer, Lead Engine, Money Model, Ask Hormozi. Use when they type /hormozi. Cite book, chapter and page. Do not invent. Do not ship Daniel's book files.

skills.name: /install-crew
skills.description: Install Chief of Staff 0.4.2 as the member's agent team. Use when they type /install-crew or say install the crew. Do not merge Your AIOS into the kit. Do not wipe agents they already have.

skills.name: /layer-1 — Context
skills.description: Build layer 1 context: the machine knows their business. Write or tighten CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md from what they tell you. Use when they type /layer-1 or say they are on the Context plate.

skills.name: /layer-2 — Data
skills.description: Build layer 2 data: make the numbers they already have askable. Use when they type /layer-2 or say they are on the Data plate.

skills.name: /layer-3 — Intelligence
skills.description: Build layer 3 intelligence: meetings, a brief they will read, always-on in the pocket, and the research shelf. Use when they type /layer-3 or mention Grok Bot / Granola / daily brief / Firecrawl / podcasts.

skills.name: /layer-4 — Automate
skills.description: Build layer 4 automate: task-audit last week, then automate only the real repeats. Use when they type /layer-4. Do not install ProductivityOS or a GTD zip.

skills.name: /layer-5 — Build
skills.description: Build layer 5: name the job that is still on them after the first four plates, then send them to /aios to pick the module that does it. Use when they type /layer-5.

skills.name: /new-app
skills.description: Turn a design into a phased build plan, then implement one phase at a time. Use when they type /new-app or hand over a mockup and say build this.

skills.name: /new-capability
skills.description: Walk them through building a skill that talks to a tool we did not ship. Use when they type /new-capability or say they need HubSpot / an internal API / a feed we have no module for.

skills.name: /podcasts
skills.description: Find the right podcast episodes, rank them, and pull full transcripts. Use when they type /podcasts or ask for interviews / episode transcripts.

skills.name: /thumbnails
skills.description: Generate on-brand video thumbnails from THEIR photos. Four concepts, then a composited headline so the text is spelled correctly. Use when they type /thumbnails or ask for a YouTube / Reels thumbnail.

skills.name: /transcripts
skills.description: Pull YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or file transcripts via Supadata. Use when they type /transcripts or paste a video URL and want the words.

skills.name: /writing-style
skills.description: Scrub AI slop from prose they are about to ship. Use when they type /writing-style, or when they ask to de-slop a draft. Voice itself is /your-voice — this skill is the editor.

skills.name: /your-brain
skills.description: Help them start THEIR memory and keep it in step across machines. Use when they type /your-brain. Never install brain-sync or turso-search.

skills.name: /your-ops
skills.description: Help them componentize THEIR invoice or ops template from a real document they sent. Use when they type /your-ops. Never ship NavAIgate letterhead or KG register facts.

skills.name: /your-voice
skills.description: Help them build THEIR voice skill from their recordings and line edits. Use when they type /your-voice. Never install daniel-voice.
